en: A multi-view color postcard. The front shows three main images of Pécs: on the left, the large domed mosque‑church on the main square with a monument and flower beds in front; in the middle, a circular inset of a tall modern TV tower; on the right, the Romanesque cathedral with its four towers seen from the square. The word "PÉCS" is printed vertically on a black strip on the right. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address section, a Hungarian stamp with 'MAGYAR POSTA', and printing details.
